text:
Maya (Sales): Quick sync — Helios Health interested in Redwood. They require SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping to AD groups, domain ownership checks. They also sent a 20‑page security questionnaire and asked whether POC can be hosted or needs private deployment. Price sensitivity but want SLA for latency.

Owen (SE): Thanks. Quick clarifying q: do they need signed assertions (SHA256)? IdP-initiated only or SP-initiated? SCIM full import or delta sync? Expected user counts?

Maya (Sales): Signed assertions SHA256, both SP & IdP flows, delta preferred but initial bulk import ok. Estimate ~50k users, ~200 groups. Session timeout 8 hours preferred, SLO required.

Ash (Solutions): We support claim-based role mapping; in Console you can map SAML groups -> Redwood roles. For Hosted API we support standard mappings; Dedicated/Private can have custom claim transforms. POC timeline usually 10-14 days. We'll need a technical contact and an IdP test tenant.

Liya (Product): Notes: Hosted has SCIM rate limit default 60 req/min; Dedicated quotas can be increased for POC. SAML: we support SHA1 and SHA256; cert rotation supported but needs coordination. Single Logout (SLO) supported but behavior varies by IdP—recommend testing.

Aisha (Security): We can provide SOC2 Type II, pen test summary, and redacted architecture diagrams. For questionnaire, send to sec-requests@redwood.com. Recommend customers require cert rotation every 90 days and KMS for Private.

Owen (SE): For 50k users I'd recommend initial bulk import via SCIM bulk + then delta. For group -> role mapping with Azure AD, here's a quick SCIM patch example we'd ask them to test:

```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-123","display":"jane.doe@example.com"}]}
  ]
}
```

Ash (Solutions): Also note Hosted default SCIM retention is 30 days for deactivated users; Dedicated can match customer retention. Pricing: estimate a 2-week Dedicated POC + engineering hours — I'll pull exact numbers and post a quote draft.

DeployBot: ticket #POC-892 created for dedicated trial provisioning.

John (Eng): Quick technical callout — for very large initial imports we run a staged import job on Dedicated to avoid rate limiting and to warm KV caches. We'll need an export CSV from their IdP if SCIM isn't fast enough.

Maya (Sales): Action items: Owen to draft questionnaire responses and attach SOC2 by EOD; Ash to draft POC quote; Aisha to send security pack; schedule kickoff Wed 10am PT. I'll loop in customer contacts.

Owen (SE): I'll draft answers and send a short answer doc + attachments. Can someone grab the standard SCIM + SAML config checklist from Docs and paste here?

Ash (Solutions): Dropping checklist link: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth/scim-saml-checklist :thumbsup:

Maya (Sales): Thanks all — will update customer after EOD.
